name: Pelta-class Assault Ship
description: The Pelta-class Assault Ship was a variant of the Pelta-class frigate. The Alliance to Restore the Republic used modified Pelta-class Assault Ships during the Galactic Civil War. At one point, a Pelta-class Assault Ship engaged and destroyed an Imperial Navy Raider-class corvette over a terrestrial body, while T-65B X-wing starfighters and TIE/ln space superiority starfighters engaged with each other near them. It was equipped with turbolasers.
